clauses.quote: The Superintendent shall also appoint the Board's representative on the committee, subject to Board approval.
The Committee shall develop guidelines, administrative procedures and for.ms for the orderly operation and administration of the Sick Leave Bank.
At a min~, said guidelines and procedures must include those provisions required by law, as found in Alabama Code, 516-22-9 (1975).
Procedures, decisions, and guidelines established by the Sick Leave Bank Committee shall include the regulations of this section.
clauses.subject_text: Procedures, decisions, and guidelines established by the Sick Leave Bank Committee

clauses.quote: Additional guidelines shall be adopted by the Sick Leave Bank Committee as may be deemed appropriate and beneficial.
No Sick Leave Bank Committee shall adopt any regulations or for.m which conflicts with the following general regulations unless otherwise required py law:
Employee membership in the sick leave bank shall be voluntary.
clauses.subject_text: Employee membership in the sick leave bank

clauses.quote: At the beginning of the scholastic year, or upon employment of a new employee, as the case may be, the appropriate number of sick leave days shall, upon application of the employee, be credited to the employee's account tq enable the employee to join the sick leave bank if the employee does not have the min~ number of sick leave days to enable h~or her to join the bank.
clauses.subject_text: the appropriate number of sick leave days

clauses.quote: Before being eligible to use catastrophic sick leave days, the member of the sick leave bank shall first borrow and utilize days from the sick leave bank, up to a max~ of 15 days.
clauses.subject_text: the member of the sick leave bank

clauses.quote: However, if the member later qualifies for c.tastrophic sick leave, donated catastrophic sick leave days may be used to repay days owed to the sick leave bank to the credit of the affected member.
No employee shall be allowed to owe more than 15 days to the sick leave bank, unless over 50 percent of the members of the bank vote to extend the limit.
Sick leave days shall be repaid to the sick leave bank monthly as re-earned by the member.

Opon the resignation or other ter.mination of an employee who has an outstanding loan of sick leave days, the value of the loan shall be deducted from the final paycheck at the employee's prevailing rate of pay.
Any alleged abuse of the use of the sick leave bank shall be investigated by the Sick Leave Bank Committee.
clauses.subject_text: Any alleged abuse of the use of the sick leave bank

clauses.quote: On the finding of wrongdoing, the member shall repay all of the sick leave credits drawn from the sick leave bank and be subject to other appropriate disciplinary action as determined by the local authority.
